paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for two audio-language models, MMAU and MMAR, evaluated on three distinct models: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis displays the three model names in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each model has two adjacent bars: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 49% accuracy, while the MMAR bar is lower at approximately 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 61% accuracy, while the MMAR bar is lower at approximately 36%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 64% accuracy, while the MMAR bar is lower at approximately 57%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
